name: kanon
description: Turn your web app into a verified knowledge base, driven from the Kanon app: /kanon:setup signs you in, /kanon:worker runs a daemon that executes what your team queues in the UI (discovery, guide scans, product changes) on your own machine, and /kanon:discover, /kanon:scan and /kanon:work still do the same work interactively; /kanon:setup-ci wires per-test coverage from your CI so passing tests verify the claims

server_url.title: Kanon server URL
server_url.description: Optional — /kanon:setup configures this; set only to override. Your Kanon instance, e.g. https://kanon.example.com (http://localhost:3000 for local dev). Can also come from KANON_URL or .kanon/config.json.

api_token.title: Kanon API token
api_token.description: Optional — /kanon:setup signs you in and stores the token in ~/.kanon/credentials.json; set this only to override with a CI/machine token. Can also come from KANON_API_TOKEN.

repo_slug.title: Default repo slug
repo_slug.description: Optional — /kanon:setup writes the repo slug into the project's .kanon/config.json; set this only to override with a global owner/repo default.
